analysis.title_zh: Granite Switch 4.1：通过同一端点处理对话、决策与语音
analysis.summary: 公告介绍了 Granite Switch 4.1 的模块化能力扩展：模型可通过同一托管端点，在自然语言回答、通用及专用决策、语音转文本任务之间切换。[S1] 其中，Granite-Switch-4.1-8B 和 -30B 配置新增面向通用决策的 Decision aLoRA，并包含专用 Guardian aLoRA。[S2] 所给资料末尾截断，无法确认后者的完整比较结果或其他配置细节。
analysis.application: 建议：【科研迁移建议】可考虑评估同一端点承接科研问答、运维事件决策和语音记录转写的可行性；这些是迁移设想，并非公告已验证的科研效果。【官方陈述】资料明确介绍多任务切换能力，但未提供上述科研场景的验证结果。[S1]
evidence: Now Granite Switch 4.1 models, armed with a Decision adapter and the fastest ASR model on the OpenASR leaderboard, can move efficiently between natural-language responses, general and specialized decisions, and speech-to-text tasks—all from one hosted endpoint.
Specifically, Granite-Switch-4.1-8B and -30B models are configured to include: A new Decision aLoRA for general-purpose decision-making (e.g. v1/systemone), A specialized Guardian aLoRA
